visual.description: Deep charcoal black used as the primary page background throughout the site.
Warm dark brown dominant tone of the hero's full-bleed caviar photograph, forming the immersive opening experience.
Slightly lighter warm dark brown used for card and section surface backgrounds.
Warm off-white used for large display headings and the main logo wordmark.
Slightly cooler off-white used for body copy and descriptive paragraph text.
Warm medium gray used for secondary labels, captions, and subdued interface text.
Pure white background for the sign-up modal overlay panel.
Near-black used for the primary Submit CTA button in the modal.
Very dark near-black used for the sticky navigation bar background.
Warm parchment/tan used for underline arrows on CTA links like 'SHOP CAVIAR' and 'SOURCING'.
Muted warm dark gray used for subtle dividers and modal input field borders.
Semi-transparent mid-gray used as the scrim behind the layered modal backdrop.
